Mobile site audit — core AMP task flows

Ticket #3027 · project navigation, My work, ticket detail, board, artifact review, modals at 320/390/430px

Baseline origin/main a02ad88Method isolated fixture + headless Chrome (emulated)Scope excludes remote chat (#3026)
Read first: the permanently-open sidebar (the old root defect) is already fixed on main — the hamburger/drawer nav and ProjectMyWork are merged. This audit is current main. Emulation does not capture the real virtual keyboard, safe-areas or pinch-zoom; those need a real device.
WORKING WELL

Already good on main

  • Hamburger → slide-in drawer nav (AppShell) — correct shared mobile pattern.
  • My work, Mission, Flight plan, Artifact view render cleanly at 390px.
  • Modals (CrudModal / ConfirmDeleteModal) are centered max-w and fit width.
  • Pinch-zoom allowed (no maximum-scale lock); viewport meta correct.
CRITICAL

D1 — TaskDrawer clipped at every phone width

TaskDrawer.tsx:166 · fixed w-[520px]

At 320px the drawer renders at left:-200px and the page cannot scroll horizontally, so the ticket title, assignee and the start of every line are unreachable. At 390/430px it is still clipped on the left (title starts mid-word).

HIGH

D2 — Project tab bar cut off, no affordance

PageHeader.tsx:33 · overflow-x-auto, scrollW 789 vs clientW 390

The 8 project tabs (Mission → Settings) overflow the viewport. The strip scrolls, but there is no fade or partial-tab cue, and the visible set ends mid-“FLIGHT PLAN”. Users cannot discover Graph / Reports / Artifacts / Library / Settings.

HIGH

D3 — Board is a 1240px kanban grid

Board.tsx:34-36,432 · LABEL_COL 240 + 5×TASK_COL 200

The board is a fixed-width kanban tuned for 13-inch screens. On a phone it needs sustained horizontal panning; epic names truncate and the state columns (SCHEDULED, Ready…) are reached only by swiping.

MEDIUM

D4 — Board action buttons 19–20px

Board.tsx:470-570 · p-1 on 14px icon

Epic/story “+ add” and “⋯ actions” buttons measure 19–20 CSS px (10 on one board). WCAG 2.5.8 / HIG target is 44px; adjacent controls invite mis-taps.

LOW–MED

D6 — Flight-plan readouts overlap

FlightPlan.tsx:200 · Readouts without wrap

Five equal readout columns at 390px; “DEPENDENCIES” / “LONGEST CHAIN” / stage labels collide. The 3-per-row phone rule only applies when wrap is passed (Mission passes it; FlightPlan does not).

FIX ORDER

Suggested sequence

  • 1. D1 TaskDrawer → full-width sheet on <sm (sequence after #3013, which also edits TaskDrawer.tsx).
  • 2. D2 tab-bar scroll fade + active-tab-into-view (or collapse to current + “more”).
  • 3. D3 board: stacked-list on <md instead of squeezed kanban (largest effort).
  • 4. D4+D5 board touch targets ≥40px + raise 10–10.5px text to ≥12px.
  • 5. D6 FlightPlan: pass wrap to Readouts (one line).

Full write-up, measurements and conflict notes: discoveries/mobile-site-audit.md (project KB). #3013 owns ProjectMyWork/HumanActions/humanActions/merge — no overlap with these fixes; #3026 owns remote chat.
